captions.text: Checking job boards every day gets old fast.
Searcher Mode runs your searches for you, on a schedule.
Open Searcher, and choose when it runs.
Pick set times of day, or a number of runs a day.
We'll add a second run in the afternoon, so new jobs get checked twice a day.
Keep running in the system tray is on by default, so closing the window won't stop your scheduled runs.
Missed runs are skipped, not made up later.
And it never applies for you.
You can also run your searches any time, with run searches now.
Every run is logged with what it found, and you get a notice in the app.
If the window is in the background, you get a Windows notification too.
New jobs wait in your Review List, already scored against your profile, ready when you are.
Get it on the Microsoft Store.
